title: HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc — Race Regulations
claims: On 2026-11-06 the regulation page is headed 2027 Regulations, so its specific clauses are not treated here as 2026 rules.
Runners must be capable of handling changing mountain conditions without outside assistance, including night, wind, cold, fog, rain and snow at altitude.
The semi-autonomy principle requires runners to carry all mandatory equipment for the whole race, and marshals may check packs at any time.
Non-compliance with a gear check can lead to disqualification.
Aid stations provide drinks and food to be consumed on site, and the organisation provides only still water and/or sports drink for refilling bottles or hydration packs.
For UTMB, CCC and TDS one personal assistant is allowed at certain aid stations, and may only hand over a bag of at most 30 litres.
In a dispute between language versions of the rules, the French version prevails.

Semi-autonomy 第 3 条：UTMB/CCC/TDS 可在指定补给站由一名助手协助，存包上限 30 L
